site.title: Tabilinks
site.motto: Your bookmarks, history & favorite pages immediately on the new tab screen.
site.motto2: Finally useful use of new tab page
site.tagline: All Your links and history, synchronized on every new tab, on every machine and on every browser You are using. Nothing get lost, You have everything with You.

home.heading: A new tab that finally does something useful
home.leadParagraph: Tabilinks replaces the unused empty new tab page with the links you actually open and use, arranged into workspaces and groups of your own, alongside your closed tabs history.

downloads.fairUseNotice: * Subject to our fair use policy - limits generous enough that almost nobody will ever reach them.

registerAction.heading: ...Or if you want synchronisation and backups
registerAction.leadText: Register the ordinary way (the registration form, then the activation link sent to your e-mail), or use Google

pairAction.headingNormalLogin: Pair the installed extension - standart account
pairAction.headingGoogleLogin: Pair the installed extension - Google-logged account
pairAction.tutorText1: 1. Once you are signed in you can reach the
pairAction.tutorText2: section, where you can have a pairing code generated.
pairAction.tutorText3: 1. Sign in to the Chrome extension with your account details.
pairAction.tutorText5: 3. Once you are signed in, the profiles, workspaces, groups and links you created locally start synchronising.
pairAction.tutorText6: You can check that you are signed in, and sign out again, from the menu.
pairAction.tutorText7: Because registering and signing in with a Google account never creates a password on this platform, pairing works a little differently.
pairAction.tutorText8: This way of pairing works for ordinary accounts too.
pairAction.tutorText9: If you have already signed out of this site, sign in again.
pairAction.tutorText10: 2. Enter the connect code in the Chrome extension.

register.heading: Create an ordinary account
register.usernameHint: 3 to 60 characters, allowed are: letters, digits, dot (.), underscore (_) and hyphen (-).
register.usernameChecking: Checking whether that username is free…
register.emailHint: The activation link is sent here.
register.displayNameHint: How you are addressed in the interface.
register.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. A long passphrase is best.
register.passwordConfirmationHint: Type the same password again. You cannot see what you typed, so this is what catches a slip.
register.emailNotDelivered: The message was not sent — the fault is on our side. You can ask for a new activation link below, but if that fails too, only we can fix it.
register.resendHint: Email can take a minute or two. If nothing turns up, ask for another activation link — it goes to the address you just entered.
register.googleAlternative: Or create your account with Google and skip having a password altogether.

login.heading: Log in
login.leadParagraph: Sign in to manage your account and the browsers connected to it.
login.googleHint: Signing in with Google creates the account the first time you use it.

activate.heading: Account activation
activate.success: Your account is active. You can log in now.
activate.missingToken: This activation link carries no token. Open the link from your email exactly as it was sent.

passwordReset.requestLead: Enter the address your account uses and we will send a reset link.
passwordReset.confirmLead: This signs every device out, so you will need to sign in again everywhere.
passwordReset.confirmSuccess: Your password is set. You can log in now.

authCallback.heading: Finishing sign-in
authCallback.missingCode: This page was opened without a sign-in code. Start again from the login page.

devices.heading: My devices
devices.leadParagraph: Every browser your account has been used from. This is a history, not a list of live sessions: a browser stays listed after it is signed out.
devices.emptyState: No browser has used this account yet.
devices.removeSuccess: That device was removed from the list.
devices.removeWarning: {deviceName} ({browserName}) stops being listed, and the dates it was first and last used go with it. This cannot be undone. Signing in from that browser again records a new device.
devices.connectLead: Generate a code and type it into the extension to sign it in. This is also how an account created with Google connects the extension, since such an account has no password.
devices.connectCodeHint: Punctuation and letter case are ignored when you type it.
devices.copyCodeFailure: The code could not be copied. Select it and copy it by hand.

inventoryState.LOCAL_ONLY_FREE_LIMIT: Only on this device - over the free plan limit
inventoryState.LOCAL_ONLY_FAIR_USE: Only on this device - over a Fair Use limit
inventoryState.EXAMPLE: Example data - not synchronised until edited

detail.heading: Device
detail.lead: What this installation holds, and which of it synchronises with your account. Data that does not synchronise stays on the device and is never deleted.
detail.noReport: This device has not reported what it holds yet. Extensions report after they synchronise; a browser where you only signed in to the website never does.

account.heading: Account
account.leadParagraph: Everything the service knows about your account, and what you can change.
account.usernameImmutable: A username cannot be changed. What this form changes is the display name.
account.emailImmutable: Moving an account to another email address is not offered either.
account.passwordSetLead: Your account has no password yet, because it was created through Google. Setting one lets you sign in without Google.
account.passwordChangeLead: Changing your password signs every device out.
account.passwordSuccess: Your password was set. Every device has been signed out.
account.dangerLead: This deletes your account and every link, group and workspace it owns. It cannot be undone.
account.deleteConfirmPrompt: Deleting is permanent. Confirm to continue.

premium.heading: Go premium
premium.lead: Unlock the full version. Pick a plan and a currency, and you will be sent to our payment provider to finish.
premium.withdrawalNotice: You can change your mind for 14 days after buying and get all of your money back, no reason needed. Nothing is deducted for the days you used it.

YEARLY_RECURRING.label: Yearly subscription
YEARLY_RECURRING.description: Renews once a year. Cancel whenever you like; you keep it until the year you paid for runs out.

LIFETIME.label: Lifetime
LIFETIME.description: Paid once. Yours for good, with nothing to renew and nothing to cancel.

premium.notAvailableYet: Buying the full version is not switched on yet. Nothing has been charged. Please try again once payments go live.
premium.subscriptionEndsWithLifetime: Your yearly subscription is cancelled automatically once the lifetime purchase is confirmed, so you are never charged for both.
premium.merchantOfRecordNotice: Payment is handled by Creem, our reseller and Merchant of Record: Creem is the seller on your receipt and takes care of payment, VAT and invoicing.
premium.grantReplacedByLifetime: Your granted year is replaced by the lifetime licence once the purchase is confirmed.

refund.heading: Changed your mind?
refund.lead: You are still inside the 14 days after buying, so you can have all of your money back. No reason needed, and nothing is deducted for the days you have used it.
refund.confirmPrompt: This returns the full amount and ends your full-version access straight away. Nothing you have created is deleted.
refund.success: Your refund is on its way. It usually reaches your account within a few working days, depending on your bank.

cancelSubscription.heading: Cancel subscription
cancelSubscription.lead: Cancelling stops the next renewal. You keep the full version until the period you have already paid for runs out, and nothing is refunded.
cancelSubscription.downgradeNotice: When the period you have paid for ends, the account goes back to the free plan. Anything over its limits stays exactly where it is and is never deleted — you can still use, edit and delete it, but you cannot add more until you are back under the limits or subscribe again.
cancelSubscription.success: Your subscription will not renew. You keep the full version until the period you have paid for ends.

grant.heading: Full version granted
grant.lifetime: An administrator has granted you the full version for life. There is nothing to buy and nothing to renew.
grant.until: An administrator has granted you the full version until {date}. It does not renew; buy the lifetime licence below to keep it for good.

legal.loadFailed: This document could not be loaded. Please try again, or write to us.

consent.registrationLead: By creating an account you agree to the
consent.registrationJoiner: and confirm you have read the
consent.purchaseLead: By proceeding to payment you agree to the

notFound.heading: Page not found
notFound.body: There is nothing at this address.

form.tooLong: This may be at most {max} characters.
form.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: The service could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unauthorized: Your session has ended. Please log in again.
errors.tooManyRequests: You are going a little too fast. Wait a moment and try again.

signIn.heading: Administrator sign-in
signIn.lead: For repairing accounts. Everything behind this page is irreversible.
signIn.lockedOut: Too many failed attempts. Sign-in is locked for a few minutes — wait rather than keep trying.

users.heading: Accounts
users.searchLabel: Search by username, email or display name
users.passwordSaved: The password was set. Its owner has not been told.
users.accountUnlocked: The failed sign-in counter was cleared.
users.accountDeleted: The account and everything it owned were deleted.

field.premiumHint: Grants the full version by hand, with no payment — for a support case or a test account. One year runs from the moment it is saved and is not renewed; choosing it again on an existing year-long grant does not extend it. "Not granted" takes the grant back.
field.premiumPaidHint: Paid through Creem. It cannot be taken away here: refund or cancel it in the Creem dashboard.

create.heading: Create an account
create.passwordHint: Optional. Without one, the account can only sign in through Google.

edit.heading: Editing {username}
edit.emailHint: Changeable here and nowhere else — users may not change their own address.
edit.newPasswordHint: Try the reset email first. Whoever asked for this gets the password, and the account's owner is not told. Leave empty to remove the password entirely.

delete.heading: Delete this account?
delete.warning: Deleting {username} also deletes every workspace, group, subgroup and link it owns. This cannot be undone. To suspend the account instead, set its status to Disabled.

new_tabs.title: New tabs opened
new_tabs.explanation: New tab pages opened in the extension, by the day of the browser that opened them.

website_visitors.title: Website visitors
website_visitors.explanation: People who visited this website, once per person per day (UTC). Robots and automated browsers are not counted.

purchaseThankYou.heading: Thank you!

confirmation.CHECKING: Your payment went through. We are confirming it with your account — this takes a few seconds.
confirmation.CONFIRMED_SUBSCRIPTION: Your yearly subscription is active. Enjoy the full version.
confirmation.CONFIRMED_LIFETIME: Your lifetime full version is active. It is yours for good.
confirmation.STILL_PENDING: Your payment went through, and the confirmation is still on its way. Your account switches to the full version on its own as soon as it arrives — there is nothing you need to do.
confirmation.SIGNED_OUT: Your payment went through. Sign in to see the full version on your account.

purchaseThankYou.extensionNote: The extension picks up the full version the next time it synchronises.
purchaseThankYou.receiptNote: A receipt is on its way to your email from Creem, our payment provider.
